Messages.Author: Andy Kaiser
L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Andy Kaiser wrote:
>
> This may have been covered already, but I've only started hanging out
> around this group recently. How does the forced withdrawal (from the
> Sabbat rules) work, exactly? As I understand it, and as my friends
> and I play it, to withdraw (as outlined in the basic game), you
> have to go one complete round (from your untap phase to your next
> untap phase) without losing any pool and without your minions getting
> into combat. If you succeed, you get a victory point for basically
> ousting yourself, and your predator gets nothing as a result of your
> leaving the game.

Correct.

> Now, if you're forced to withdraw as a result of
> running out of cards, does that mean you have to just sit there and
> take whatever punishment your predator or anyone else feels like
> dishing out on you, all the time saying "I've gotta withdrawal," not
> blocking anything, until your predator kills you off and gets his
> victory point?

No. Under the Sabbat Withdrawal rule, you simply withdraw.
Immediately.
You start your turn with fewer cards in your hand than your hand
capacity
due to have exhausted your library, and that's it - you successfully
withdraw. Pick up all your cards and sit back.

--

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com) wrote:

: No. Under the Sabbat Withdrawal rule, you simply withdraw.

: Immediately.
: You start your turn with fewer cards in your hand than your hand
: capacity
: due to have exhausted your library, and that's it - you successfully
: withdraw. Pick up all your cards and sit back.

Actually, according to the Sabbat rules sheet, you do not pick up all your
cards and go home. This is (to my mind) another strike against the Sabbat
withdrawal rule - it breaks the rule that, whenever a Methuselah leaves the
game, all his/her cards go with them. According to the Sabbat withdrawal
method, any cards the withdrawing Meth has that are still in play on other
people's sides remain in play until the game ends.

Josh

..bitter, bitter, bitter..
